rows.grounds: denotes the navel as a reference point
ablative of madhya fused with particle tu
compound specifying a measure of one finger-breadth

items.question: What alternative bodily locations and measures are specified for this placement?
premises: The right side is named as one location.
The middle of the navel is given as another reference point.
A measure of one divine-fire finger-breadth is indicated as an alternative.
items.inference: The placement may be determined either on the right side or by a one-finger-breadth measure from the middle of the navel.
uncertainties: The precise technical meaning of devavahni-aṅgula in this ritual context is unclear.
items.plain_english: On the right side, or else from the middle of the navel, it is one finger-breadth of the divine fire.
